in_sanskrit.name: Dalbir
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Servant of Dharma
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dalbir एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Dalbir is derived from Sanskrit. It is a compound of two words: Dal and Bir. Dal means servant or devoted, and Bir means dharma or righteousness. Thus, Dalbir can be translated as 'Servant of Dharma'. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu tradition and is considered to be a strong and meaningful name for a baby boy.
